title: Astro Portal session event payload: condition
description: A weather/seeing field note: what the sky is doing, not what the equipment is doing (see equipment_issue for that). Every field is optional so a single tap (e.g. a sky-state icon) already produces a valid event, but at least one of sky/seeing/transparency/notes must be present — an empty condition event carries no information. No GPS or precise position is ever part of this payload: the session's own location, if any, comes from its plan. `cause` names what in the sky is the trouble (clouds, wind, dew): it is what lets a target given up for `weather` be counted under wind or dew rather than clouds. See session-events.md for what this type is for and what it deliberately is not.

sky.description: How the sky looks. `hazy` and `cloudy` are the one-tap states of the execution screen's sky sheet (« Voilé », « Nuageux »); the finer clear/mostly/partly/overcast steps stay available for other emitters.

cause.description: Optional: what in the sky is the trouble right now — clouds, wind or dew. A target_skipped with reason `weather` is counted under the cause of the latest condition carrying one, recorded before the skip; clouds when none says otherwise.
